description: Machine session state. Provider-neutral: every agent (Claude, Codex, Gemini, or any other) and every human reads this before governed work. Update it at end of session and point active_handoff at the newest handoff.
next_allowed_move: Obtain the exact repository URL/path set and intended absorption outcome from the operator, then create a bounded source-intake/corpus receipt before any scan or absorption.
commit_discipline: Commit and push to origin main as soon as each roadmap tranche is complete and gates pass. Do not batch multiple tranches into one commit. Commit message must name the tranche id and verification result. See history_index for the full historical commit-discipline record and its named example commits.
blocked_work: Restating P4-A/P3-B/Phase 3 bounded closure as application-level AI wiring, durable accounting, production provider integration, RAG, deployment or production readiness.
Any new P4-E product repair without a new admitted finding. P4-E and its Amendment 2 closure choreography are closed bounded at their recorded commits.

Treating CVF_SESSION/ACTIVE_SESSION_STATE.json as a canonical or independent source of truth - it is a compatibility mirror only, required by scripts/check_cvf_workspace_agent_enforcement.ps1's literal path check; SESSION/ACTIVE_SESSION_STATE.json is the sole canonical active state. Run python scripts/check_session_state.py (verify_mirror_drift) before finishing any session that edits either file.
Mutating the hidden public Core or private provenance from this project. Both are read-only authority references; refresh them only through their own governed repository workflows.
Cloning, fetching, scanning, or absorbing an external repository before the operator identifies the exact source set and intended outcome and a bounded corpus receipt is opened.

Rewriting, squashing, amending, or force-pushing any settled historical commit (see history_index for the full guardrail list preserved from the pre-T3 archive) - corrective work lands in new commits only.
Restating any bounded historical closure as 'all findings fixed' - see history_index archive for the full per-tranche claim-boundary record.
